purpose: Teach: カーペット/バイブル/粥/開封/迷路/曲がる/下校/高血圧

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、学校の、本気で、絶対、カーペット、絶対、新しくなったよね
lines.en: Riku, the school carpet really did get replaced, didn't it?
lines.style: Bright, conversational observation. Casual lilt upward at the end. Quick pace, natural. Like she's noticing something out loud with him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。先生の教科書、本気で、絶対、バイブル、絶対、扱いされてるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. The way teachers treat the textbooks—like it's basically scripture, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Thoughtful tempo. Slight smile in the voice. Not performing—just noticing something alongside her, with warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、風邪気味の時、絶対、粥、絶対、食べた方がいいよ、リク
lines.en: You should eat porridge when you're coming down with something, Riku.
lines.style: Soft directive, not bossy. Genuine care underneath. Slight hesitation—checking that he'll take it seriously. Warm but matter-of-fact, like something she's learned matters.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前から、本気で、絶対、もらった手紙、絶対、開封、絶対、するの、絶対、ドキドキしたぜ、桜
lines.en: Opening the letter you sent me made my heart race, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter, more vulnerable. Each word deliberate. Nervous energy held in check. The admission costs him something—delivered steady despite the flutter underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 校舎の中、本気で、絶対、新一年生、絶対、迷路、絶対、みたいって、絶対、言ってたよ、リク
lines.en: The new first-years were saying the school building is like a maze, right?
lines.style: Observational, almost amused. Warm familiarity. Sharing something she noticed, inviting him into the joke. Light and easy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 駅前で、本気で、絶対、右に、絶対、曲がるとお店、絶対、あるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: If you turn right at the station, there's a shop there, you know.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. Slight enthusiasm underneath—he knows this place, knows it matters. Sharing information like he's thinking of where they could go.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 下校時、本気で、絶対、二人で、絶対、寄り道、絶対、しちゃおうよ、リク
lines.en: Let's take the long way home together after school, yeah?
lines.style: Bright invitation. Quick, hopeful pace. Direct—not tentative. The small thrill of suggesting something with him. Straightforward warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、高血圧で、絶対、最近、絶対、塩分、絶対、控えているんだぜ、桜
lines.en: My grandfather's been cutting back on salt because of his blood pressure lately.
lines.style: Conversational shift to something more serious. Steadier pace. Matter-of-fact but tinged with quiet concern underneath. Mentioning something that's been on his mind.
